title: Eric Davis offers full testimony for blanket immunity

tellings.quote: Eric Davis is actually on record as part of James Fox's last movie saying if you give me blanket immunity, I will say everything I know.

plain: A physicist named Eric W. Davis, who has advised the Pentagon on UFO questions, is said to have offered to tell everything he knows if he were given blanket legal immunity. The mathematician Eric Weinstein tells Michels that Davis says so on record in the most recent film by the documentary maker James Fox. If true, it would mean Davis holds secrets he feels he cannot legally share.
